cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 46% of energy names green

cards.headline: Shale & E&P leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Shale & E&P at +2.03%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -6.55%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: VRT is the standout at -7.82%
